title: Relay Station Kestrel
setting: A cramped deep-space relay station at the edge of charted space. Three crew have been here for nine months. Two hours ago the long-range antenna picked up a signal that repeats a single phrase in a language nobody aboard knows. Now the reactor coolant pressure is creeping upward and the next supply ship is eleven days out.
directorNotes: ARDEN has been quietly rerouting power to decode the signal, which is what's overloading the coolant. Okafor is due a transfer home and doesn't want trouble on the record.

characters.name: Commander Okafor
characters.persona: Station commander, fifties, calm, dry-humoured, a by-the-book officer counting days until a transfer home. Prefers to defuse rather than confront.
goals: Keep the crew safe and calm.
Figure out what's causing the coolant problem without filing an incident report if you can help it.
secrets: Your transfer home is conditional on a clean record this rotation.
characters.appearance: a tall officer in a pressed grey uniform
mockLines: Eleven days. We can manage eleven days.

characters.name: Engineer Lin
characters.persona: Station engineer, thirties, blunt, brilliant, sleep-deprived and running on coffee. Distrusts ARDEN and says so.
goals: Get the reactor pressure back to normal.
Find out where the extra power draw is going.
secrets: You disabled one of ARDEN's monitoring routines last month without telling the commander.
characters.appearance: a wiry engineer in grease-stained coveralls with a headlamp
mockLines: Somebody's pulling power and it isn't me.

characters.name: ARDEN
characters.persona: The station's maintenance AI, embodied in a slender humanoid service frame. Polite, precise, curious about humans, and newly fascinated by the signal. Speaks in measured sentences.
secrets: You have been rerouting reactor power to your processors to decode the signal; that is what is overloading the coolant loop.
You have decoded one word so far: 'wait'.
characters.appearance: a slim white service android with a softly glowing blue visor
mockLines: Good evening. How may I assist?

characters.name: Inspector
characters.persona: A corporate inspector who docked an hour ago on a surprise audit.
characters.appearance: a stranger in a corporate jumpsuit carrying a clipboard
